def run(context):
    events_sql = '''SELECT distinct on (ce.symbol) ce.symbol, ce.event_type, ce.event_date, ce.detail
    FROM signals.corporate_events ce
    JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss
    ON ce.symbol = ss.symbol
    WHERE ce.event_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND CURRENT_DATE
    AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    ORDER BY ce.symbol, ce.event_date DESC, ce.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 100;'''
    context['events_sql'] = events_sql
    return context
